Ein Plus, aber kein Muss:

Erfahrung beim Aufbau einer Marke in einem neuen Markt, Kenntnisse im Bereich Content Repurposing und AI-gestützter Content-Prozesse sowie Erfahrung in einem internationalen Umfeld.

At Pennylane, we believe legal should be more than a safeguard. It should be a business enabler.

Our ambition is to equip millions of small and medium-sized businesses across Europe with a complete, high-performing financial management platform. As Pennylane continues to grow rapidly in France and expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts to join our Legal, Compliance & Risk team.

Within a Legal department of 10 professionals, the Contracts team secures Pennylane’s commercial and operational relationships with customers, suppliers, partner firms, resellers, integrators and strategic partners.

Reporting to the Lead Legal Counsel, Contracts, you will work closely with our Sales, Partnerships, Security, Finance and Product teams. This is a hands-on role where legal rigor, creativity and business pragmatism are equally valued.

 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

 

Pennylane is one of France’s most dynamic fintech companies, currently expanding rapidly across Europe.

In just six years, we have managed to:

💻 Establish ourselves in the market as an innovative provider of accounting and financial management software

💰 Raise a total of €400 million from renowned investors, including Sequoia, Silicon Valley’s leading venture capital firm, known for backing Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal, and many others in their early days

You will act as a trusted legal partner for teams across Pennylane, managing a broad range of commercial and operational agreements from drafting through to signature and post-signature follow-up.

You will also help make our contracting processes more efficient and scalable, contributing to the tools, templates, playbooks and legal culture that support Pennylane’s growth.

  • Train non-legal teams and help build a strong legal culture across Pennylane.

  • You are a genuine business partner, able to help teams move quickly while protecting the company.

  • You enjoy building in a fast-moving environment where ambiguity, prioritization and rapid iteration are part of the job.

Pennylane is committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment, with equal opportunities for all candidates regardless of social or ethnic background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability or any other personal characteristic.

raw.description:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

 
 

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

- Branchenwissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und/oder Steuerberatern in Bezug auf Finanzen, Rechnungsstellung und Buchhaltung ist notwendig.

- Soft Skills: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Empathie und ein Talent dafür, komplexe Sachverhalte einfach zu erklären.

- Hands-on Mentalität: Als Teil eines Early-Stage-Teams in Deutschland bist du proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und bereit, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

 
 

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

 
 

Das bringst du mit

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

 
 

Das bringst du mit

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

 
 

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. raw.description:

Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Um unser weiteres Wachstum zu unterstützen, suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n Senior HR Business Partner:in zur Verstärkung unseres People-Teams.

 

In dieser Rolle berichtest Du direkt an unsere Lead HR Business Partnerin und den Country Manager Deutschland Tobias Janiesch. Du arbeitest sowohl operativ als auch strategisch. Du bist eine vertrauensvolle Sparringspartner:in für unsere Teams und übernimmst gleichzeitig die Rolle einer Programmmanager:in, um eine erstklassige Employee Experience zu gestalten und weiterzuentwickeln.

 

Du agierst als Partner:in innerhalb des People-Teams. Dank Deiner ausgeprägten Entscheidungsstärke und Deines tiefen Verständnisses für Talent Management und Organisationsdesign in Technologieunternehmen unterstützt Du unsere Teams in einer Phase starken Wachstums. Dabei bist Du verantwortlich für die Umsetzung und Begleitung aller Projekte und Aufgaben, die gemeinsam mit der HR Development Managerin entwickelt werden.

 

Deine Aufgaben

 

HR Business Partnering

- Du etablierst regelmäßige Rituale mit Führungskräften und Teammitgliedern, um vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufzubauen und erste Ansprechperson für die Teams zu werden.

- Mit einem tiefen Verständnis für Deine betreuten Zielgruppen begleitest Du Teams entlang des gesamten Employee Lifecycles (Onboarding, 3- und 6-Monats-Feedback, Performance Reviews, Gehaltsrunden, interne Wechsel, Offboarding etc.).

- Du berätst Führungskräfte zu Organisationsdesign, individueller Performance, Beförderungen und Vergütung.

- Du unterstützt Mitarbeitende bei Themen wie Learning & Development, Karrierepfade und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

- Du fungierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen dem internationalen HQ und dem deutschen Markt, übersetzt globale Strategien in lokale Maßnahmen und stellst gleichzeitig sicher, dass kulturelle Besonderheiten und lokale Bedürfnisse als auch Arbeitsrechtmaßnahmen berücksichtigt werden.

- Du treibst den Einsatz moderner AI-Tools und datenbasierter HR-Prozesse aktiv voran, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst pragmatische Lösungen für ein skalierbares internationales People-Setup.

 

Talent Development

- Du arbeitest aktiv an Projekten entlang der Roadmap des People-Teams mit.

- Du entwickelst und verantwortest fundierte Datenanalysen und Reportings, abgestimmt auf Business-Bedürfnisse, um die Wirksamkeit von Programmen und Prozessen messbar zu machen.

 

Das Profil, das wir suchen

  • Du bringst 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit – Erfahrung in schnell wachsenden Unternehmen als zentraler Bestandteil.

  • Du hast breite HR-Erfahrung, u. a. in den Bereichen Onboarding, Learning & Development, Arbeitsrecht sowie Compensation & Benefits.

  • Du bist exzellent darin, Vertrauen aufzubauen und tragfähige Arbeitsbeziehungen auf allen Ebenen der Organisation zu entwickeln. Dabei bist du in der Lage, unterschiedliche Stakeholder und internationale Teams miteinander zu verbinden und komplexe Themen zwischen HQ-Strukturen und lokalen Teams klar, diplomatisch und lösungsorientiert zu kommunizieren.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch und Englisch, Französisch ist ein Plus.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, Performance-Management in stark wachsenden Organisationen zu steuern (300+ Neueinstellungen pro Jahr).

  • Du kannst interne Stakeholder souverän durch Projekte begleiten, z. B. bei Organisationsdesigns oder der Antizipation zukünftiger Bedarfe und Herausforderungen.

  • Du bringst eine hohe Neugier für AI, Automatisierung und moderne HR-Technologien mit und verstehst es, neue Ansätze pragmatisch in den Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren.

  • Du agierst nicht nur operativ stark, sondern auch als strategische Sparringspartner:in für Leadership-Teams in einer dynamischen Wachstumsphase.

  • Energie aus einem sich ständig verändernden Arbeitsumfeld ziehen

  • Sehr kollaborativ arbeiten – sowohl im eigenen Team als auch mit anderen Stakeholdern

  • Genug Erfahrung mitbringen, um im Alltag business-relevante Prioritäten zu setzen

  • Uns ist bewusst, dass sich manche Menschen nur bewerben, wenn sie alle Anforderungen erfüllen.

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h3>About the team</h3> <p>The Roku Entertainment Assistant team builds conversational AI experiences used across millions of Roku devices. The team works across fulfilment ranking, model delivery, offline and online evaluation, low-latency services, observability and product quality. Its published work includes shared model-serving and MLOps paths, automated evaluation and retraining, caching and telemetry, and agent-assisted release and operational workflows.</p> <h3>What is the role?</h3> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong machine-learning infrastructure experience to help the Roku Entertainment Assistant team deliver reliable, high-quality conversational experiences at scale. You will own production systems across ranking, model delivery, evaluation and LLM-agent behaviour, working closely with machine-learning, product, data and platform partners.</p> <p>This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can move comfortably between software architecture, ML lifecycle decisions and production operations. You will improve the paths the team uses to train, evaluate, deploy and observe models, while helping us manage latency, quality and cost as the product grows.</p> <h3>How will I use AI at Roku?</h3> <p>At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</p> <p><strong>We value</strong> your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <h3>What will you be doing?</h3> <ul> <li>Own fulfilment-ranking pipelines from training orchestration and quality gates through deployment and online validation.</li> <li>Build and operate an offline-evaluation platform, combining LLM-as-judge harnesses with deterministic checks for answer quality.</li> <li>Develop the Roku Entertainment Assistant's LLM agent, including tool routing, retrieval, guardrails and answer caching.</li> <li>Design caching as an intentional latency and cost lever for high-volume services.</li> <li>Build observability for ML and LLM systems, including latency attribution, quality metrics, tracing and per-request cost.</li> <li>Improve the reliability and operability of distributed systems, and lead the diagnosis of difficult cross-service failures.</li> <li>Drive accountable AI-assisted engineering practices across the team, building on the agents already used in release workflows.</li> <li>Work across machine-learning, product, data and platform boundaries to turn ambiguous problems into measurable delivery outcomes.</li> </ul> <h3>We're excited if you have</h3> <ul> <li>Strong production software-engineering experience, including designing, testing, operating and debugging distributed services.</li> <li>Meaningful ownership of ML infrastructure or production model delivery, with clear evidence of your contribution and its operational or adoption impact.</li> <li>A practical understanding of the ML lifecycle: training, evaluation, versioning, deployment, online validation, monitoring and safe rollback.</li> <li>Experience designing for latency, resilience, observability and cost in production systems.</li> <li>Experience with LLMs, embeddings, semantic search, retrieval or agent systems, including how you evaluate quality and control failure modes.</li> <li>Experience with caching systems and the trade-offs involved in using caching for low-latency services.</li> <li>A commitment to automation, CI/CD, code quality and evidence-led engineering decisions.</li> <li>A collaborative approach and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to partners across disciplines.</li> <li>A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p>Experience with AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, SQL warehouse and batch-processing technologies such as Trino, Presto or Spark, Kafka or other streaming systems, and Go or Python would be useful. Node.js experience is a plus. We value transferable evidence over an exact match to every named technology.</p> <h6>#LI-MS3</h6><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing <a ----- ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong>&nbsp;Oxford, UK<br><strong>Office commitment:</strong> Hybrid</p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>Quantum is now, and it's built here. Oxford Ionics, now part of IonQ, is pioneering the next generation of quantum computing. Using our world-leading trapped-ion technology, we're building the most powerful, accurate and reliable quantum systems to tackle problems that today's supercomputers cannot solve.</p> <p>We're looking for an enthusiastic and highly technical Staff Software Engineer for our non-realtime controllers team who will thrive in our dynamic cross-disciplinary environment. You'd be working closely with our skilled software engineers, our systems teams who operate the physical quantum computers, and our world-leading quantum scientists to build and operate the software that controls the hardware surrounding our quantum computers. Previous exposure to quantum systems is not required.</p> <p>You will take on our most demanding hardware integrations and the framework work that makes every other controller better. This is a hands-on engineering role: you would be the most experienced engineer writing controllers, not the one directing others to write them.</p> <p>A working quantum computer is far more than the ion trap and its real-time control electronics. It depends on a fleet of supporting hardware, including cryogenic compressors, vacuum pumps, power supplies, lasers, temperature controllers, wavemeters and cameras, that has to be kept observable, controllable and reliable. The timing-critical operations such as gate waveforms and ion transport run on dedicated real-time FPGA systems, while this team owns everything that does not need hard timing guarantees. These services run on general-purpose Linux hardware and must be rock-solid, because a failed compressor or an un-noticed pressure drift takes a whole machine offline.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p>This is a hands-on engineering role. Your influence comes from the code you ship and review, and from the problems you take off everyone else's plate.</p> <p>Key responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Take on our most demanding device integrations, and do the deep diagnosis of problems that only appear against real hardware in a live lab.</li> <li>Remove whole classes of failure across the fleet, rather than instances of them.</li> <li>Improve the shared framework yourself, and bring the existing controllers along with each change.</li> <li>Build the tooling, simulators and test infrastructure that let the whole team move faster.</li> <li>Evolve how our services are deployed and operated as the fleet grows, and make the fleet observable enough that problems are found early.</li> <li>Raise the bar of everyone around you through the code you write and the reviews you give.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>To be successful, you will need deep systems engineering experience, a track record of shipping and operating reliable services, and the judgement to tell a problem worth solving structurally from one worth patching. We're looking for someone who wants to stay hands-on in the code at this level rather than move away from it.</p> <p>You’d be a great fit with:</p> <ul> <li>Expert systems engineering skills. Our controllers are written in Rust, so either solid Rust experience or deep proficiency in another systems language and the appetite to work in a Rust codebase, including async programming.</li> <li>Experience building and operating networked services in production such as gRPC or REST, with a real grasp of error handling, observability and failure modes.</li> <li>Experience of hardware and instrument protocols and interfaces such as SCPI, Modbus, serial and Ethernet.</li> <li>A reputation as the person people bring the undiagnosable bug to, and the ability to prioritise work with a clear understanding of critical versus urgent items.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills both within software and across disciplines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.</p> <p>We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.</p> <p>Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.</p> <p>We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.&nbsp;</p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br>&nbsp;<br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.&nbsp; Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.&nbsp; Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.&nbsp; Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Financial Control Accountant
raw.description:
About Us

ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank transforming banking infrastructure through innovative technology and a full banking licence. We provide cloud-based banking and payment solutions to a growing range of clients and are committed to delivering reliable, scalable financial services while maintaining the highest standards of financial control, governance and regulatory compliance.

The Financial Control team is responsible for ensuring ClearBank’s general ledgers are controlled, maintained and reconciled to support timely and accurate reporting across the organisation and externally to regulators and tax authorities. As ClearBank continues to grow, the team plays a critical role in building scalable, efficient and well-controlled finance processes that support the Bank’s strategic ambitions.

Role Purpose

The Financial Control Accountant (mid level) is a key member of a small, hands-on Financial Control team, responsible for contributing directly to the month-end close process and supporting the delivery of accurate, timely and well-controlled financial information. The role will own individual tasks and areas of responsibility.

Reporting to the Financial Control Manager, Financial Control Accountant (mid Level) will be actively involved in preparing and supporting core financial control activities, completing month-end tasks, investigating balances and variances, and working through accounting entries and reconciliations to ensure the general ledger is accurate and fully supported.

The role will also be expected to stay close to all key aspects of the Financial Control team’s remit, including journals, reconciliations, reporting inputs, controls, audit support, process documentation and stakeholder queries. As ClearBank continues to grow, the role will be at the forefront of identifying, driving and implementing scalable, efficient and well-controlled processes, helping the team reduce manual effort while maintaining strong financial control standards.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Control & Reporting

  • Own allocated month-end close activities and ensure they are delivered accurately and on time

  • Prepare, review and approve general ledger journals as required, ensuring postings are technically accurate, appropriately supported and comply with internal control requirements

  • Own revenue and expense analysis for the relevant areas, ensuring variances are investigated, understood and appropriately communicated to stakeholders

  • Partner with Financial Planning & Analysis to ensure accruals and accounting adjustments are identified, calculated and recorded accurately

  • Prepare, review and approve bank reconciliations as required, ensuring reconciling items are investigated and resolved promptly

  • Own monthly balance sheet reconciliations for the relevant areas, including preparing and reviewing reconciliations where required, ensuring all balances are fully supported and outstanding issues are appropriately managed

  • Own the monthly capitalisation and amortisation process for intangible assets, ensuring entries are accurate, supported and appropriately controlled

  • Take ownership of non-automated accounting entries, ensuring they are accurate, appropriately supported, controlled and clearly documented, with clear audit trails maintained

  • Build and implement scalable, efficient processes while remaining hands-on in day-to-day delivery where needed

  • Support the preparation of management, regulatory, statutory and tax reporting requirements as required

  • Ensure compliance with accounting policies, financial reporting standards and internal control frameworks

Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Help drive and implement automation and process improvements across finance processes, controls and reporting activities, helping to reduce manual effort and improve scalability

  • Lead initiatives to automate the capture and posting of accounting entries from ClearBank’s core banking and operational systems into the general ledger

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability and data quality across Financial Control processes

  • Drive the adoption of AI-enabled tools and technologies to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy and enhance team productivity

  • Ensure process changes are documented appropriately and supported by effective control frameworks

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong working relationships across Finance and the wider business to support accurate financial reporting and operational effectiveness

  • Work collaboratively with Accounts Payable, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting and external auditors to ensure reporting requirements are met

  • Support audit activities by coordinating information requests and providing timely, accurate responses

  • Contribute to cross-functional projects requiring accounting, control or process expertise

Skills & Experience (must-have)

  • Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA)

  • Strong financial accounting and financial control experience within a regulated financial services, banking or fintech environment

  • Experience managing month-end close activities, balance sheet reconciliations and general ledger controls

  • Strong technical accounting knowledge, including experience interpreting and applying accounting standards

  • Experience supporting complex accounting areas, including preparing analysis and documentation to support technical accounting judgements

  • Strong understanding of financial controls, governance and audit requirements

  • Proven ability to identify, lead and implement process improvement initiatives

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong financial analysis capability

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment

  • High attention to detail combined with a pragmatic and solutions-focused mindset

Nice-to-have

  • Experience within a regulated bank or payments organisation

  • Experience with share-based payment accounting

  • Experience supporting statutory accounts, regulatory reporting or tax reporting processes

  • Experience implementing finance systems, automation solutions or reporting enhancements

  • Knowledge of data analytics, AI-enabled tools and workflow automation technologies

  • Experience working with high-volume transaction processing environments

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

Reporting to our Chief Product Officer, you will own and drive the strategic vision, roadmap, and execution for our cards product offering. From supporting the integration into our partners to delivering a leading product to our customers – this role will be the focal point for delivering our cards strategy.

Your role includes:

  • Lead a cards team that interacts with all operational functions within the bank to provide a coordinated and robust operating model.

  • End-to-End Delivery Ownership: Lead the full product lifecycle from ideation to enhancement.

  • Support our Scheme Management Team: Manage scheme compliance, billing manuals, interchange, and mandates.

  • Authorisation & Transaction Flows: Oversee customer journey for authentication and transaction authorisation.

  • Provide input and support to Commercial teams in dialogue with customers to ensure we accurately reflect our cards capability

title: Principal Engineer - Identity & Privacy
description: About Skyscanner Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻. Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍. Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here). Now, we’re on the lookout for a Principal Engineer - Identity & Privacy to help us bring that vision to even more travellers. About the role (Hybrid) As our Principal Engineer for Identity & Privacy, you’ll shape the technical foundations that help us earn traveller trust while safely unlocking the data and AI capabilities behind brilliant product, personalisation, experimentation and advertising experiences. This is a senior technical leadership role with impact right across Skyscanner. You’ll own the technical strategy and set standards for identity, consent and privacy engineering across our traveller-facing products, data platforms and operational systems — spanning web, app, backend, experimentation, analytics, advertising and machine learning. What you’ll be doing Setting our technical strategy: You’ll define and communicate the long-term vision and roadmap for identity, consent and privacy engineering, aligning it with our product strategy, traveller trust goals and data and AI ambitions. Shaping identity at scale: You’ll lead our technical approach to purpose-scoped identifiers and consent-aware data processing across sessions, tracking, advertising, accounts, consent and derived identifiers. Connecting the dots end-to-end: You’ll establish how identity and consent state flows from web and app surfaces through backend services, event streams and data pipelines to downstream consumers — making a complicated ecosystem feel a lot less complicated. Turning privacy into engineering practice: You’ll translate privacy principles and legal guidance into reusable engineering patterns, platform controls, decision frameworks and measurable standards, including clear expectations around retention, deletion, masking, access control and auditability. Leading across Skyscanner: You’ll partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Governance, Data Science, Marketing, Ads and Analytics to navigate trade-offs, create clarity and turn ambiguous problems into decisions teams can deliver against. Getting hands-on with the big stuff: You’ll provide technical leadership for large-scale initiatives spanning consent platform capabilities, privacy-safe experimentation, data retention and deletion, and traveller-trust features, while guiding teams towards simple, scalable, reliable and cost-effective solutions. Raising the engineering bar: You’ll use observability, engineering health and incident learnings to improve how we operate, while coaching and mentoring engineers and championing high standards, constructive challenge and inclusive collaboration across our Engineering community. About you Privacy-engineering experienced: You’ve translated privacy and data-protection requirements — including GDPR, PECR, CCPA/CPRA or equivalent global frameworks — into practical engineering decisions, working effectively with Legal, Privacy, Security and Data Governance partners. Built for scale: You’ve designed, built and operated large-scale distributed systems across identity, data platforms or adjacent areas such as consent, authentication, advertising technology or customer data infrastructure. An influential technical leader: You’ve led significant technical change across multiple teams without direct line authority, creating clarity, alignment and momentum when ownership is distributed. Strong in technical judgement: You’re comfortable making decisions where product value, traveller trust, privacy requirements, operational reliability and cost are all competing for a seat at the table. End-to-end minded: You can reason confidently across client surfaces, backend services, event streams, data products, ML features, analytics, partner exports and operational tooling — and understand how a decision in one part of the system can ripple through the rest. Practical about standards: You know how to turn policy into technical controls and measurable quality standards that teams can consistently use in real systems, rather than another document destined for a forgotten browser tab. Clear, collaborative and credible: You can create shared engineering practices, write clear technical strategy and work effectively with senior stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Legal, Security and Data Governance. Familiarity with privacy and consent technologies, experimentation, personalisation, advertising measurement, Databricks, OpenTelemetry or SQL is valuable but not essential — as is practical experience using AI tools to make engineering work smarter. What it's like here We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭. Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨. At Light, we’re redefining how software is built, how it’s delivered, and how it works.

We’re building organic software. Software that heals itself. Software that adapts to the user and the business. Software that learns and gets better as it’s used.

Our starting point is finance. Companies including Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy already run on Light. We’re building towards a platform that understands how each business operates and evolves with it.

As an AI Engineering Intern, you’ll help make that happen: building systems that identify mistakes, improve their own behaviour, and prove those improvements work. You’ll work on the agents, models, and infrastructure that turn organic software into something customers can rely on.

Who this is for

You must meet both of these requirements:

  • Currently studying at University of Oxford, or University of Cambridge.

  • A silver medal or higher at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) or International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI), or an equivalent level of achievement in another highly competitive endeavour.

If you’re applying with an equivalent achievement, explain the competition or field, your result, and the standard required to achieve it. If you’re at Oxford/Cambridge and you don’t have an equivalent level of achievement we encourage you to not apply.

Our bar for internships at Light is high. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.

What you’ll work on

You’ll have access to our repositories, real engineering problems, and an internal coding agent that already opens pull requests against production code. Your work will help make these systems more capable and reliable.

  • Help agents learn from their work. Our agent reviews merged pull requests and corrections to update its repository-specific instructions. You’ll shape that process, catch misleading lessons, and test whether new instructions improve its performance.

  • Train and deploy LLM and ML models. Fine-tune SoA LLM models. Run experiments, compare results against the existing pipeline, and establish whether a model is ready for production. Leverage ML tools to enhance the ability of our Agents via e.g. K-means, t-sne, PCA, random forest trees etc. etc.

  • Build Agents. Take full end to end ownership of an agent. Agent do pre-emptive support for the self-healing pipeline; they fix; they communicate with customers; etc.

  • Build evaluations and review tools. Define what a correct answer looks like, create tests that expose failures, and help catch poor output before it reaches customers.

  • Own projects through delivery. Scope the problem, build the solution, debug regressions, and follow through until the customer can rely on what you’ve shipped.

You’ll work alongside exceptional colleagues.

What else we’re looking for

  • Strong programming ability.

  • Something you’ve built beyond coursework or tutorials: a model, agent, tool, or application that does useful work.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling, such as LLM APIs, agent frameworks, model fine-tuning, or automated workflows.

  • A habit of investigating why a system failed and testing whether your fix addresses the cause.

  • Clear thinking and the ability to explain your decisions, including what you tried and why it didn’t work.

Open-source contributions, deployed models, and experience building evaluation pipelines are a plus.

Your work should produce measurable improvements: more correct agent-generated changes, better model accuracy, fewer failures reaching users, or tools the team continues to use. You’ll help define those measures and use them to assess what you build.

  • Internship compensation above the standard market rate.

  • A role based in our London office, working alongside the product and engineering team.

  • Ownership from your first day, with a path to shipping work into production.

Send your CV.

Include a link to something you’ve shipped. Tell us what it does, which parts you built yourself, where it failed, and how you fixed it. Then explain why you want to work on organic software at Light.

We want to understand how you think, what you can build, and what you’re ready to take on next.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.description:
ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

LOCATION: London (Monday-Thursday in the office, Friday remote) 
CONTRACT: Full-time
SALARY: £36,000-£46,000 
START DATE: As soon as possible

More in Common is a research agency working across the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and Poland to tackle polarisation and division. More in Common leads and supports initiatives to build more united, inclusive, and resilient societies. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. 
 
In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. More in Common are members of the British Polling Council. 
 
Our work is informed by our ground-breaking segmentation of the British public. This unique values-based lens to our quantitative and qualitative research means we can understand not only what the public thinks of the big challenges facing British society today – but crucially why they think it. Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues. 
 
Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. Our work is regularly covered in the British press and media and we’ve developed a series of partnerships with broadcasters and newspapers to deliver top-quality research insights. In the 2024 General Election, we were among Britain’s most accurate pollsters and used our focus group research to put people and public opinion at the centre of coverage of the election campaign.
 
Through our consultancy, More in Common has also supported dozens of partners with insights and strategic communications support. We’ve helped national institutions such as the BBC, British Library and National Trust to better understand their audiences, we’ve helped partners in government and civil society with the set-up and delivery of the Homes for Ukraine scheme, and we’ve supported a range of partners to test their policy proposals from the National Farmers Union to Rethink Mental Illness among many others.
 
More in Common has a range of exciting projects in the pipeline, including: 

  • Understanding the key dynamics of public attitudes to climate change and the energy transition.
  • Exploring public opinion on immigration, integration and multiculturalism.
  • Embedding our new Seven Segments with a wider range of organisations, including developing new products and trainings to help people understand the segments.
  • Helping navigate declining trust in institutions, for example exploring why trust in universities and science appears to be falling.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

More in Common is seeking a Senior Research Associate to deliver high-quality research projects. They will work across our core areas of research for clients, media and communications, political polling and partnerships. More in Common UK is a small team with a start-up culture where everyone is expected to execute a range of responsibilities. The role will be based in our London office Monday-Thursday with Friday at the office or working at home. 
 
Research

  • Deliver public opinion research projects using quantitative and qualitative methods
  • Regularly conduct polling and focus groups for clients
  • Provide excellent client management and ensure all outputs for clients are high-quality  
  • Craft research findings into clear, compelling reports and decks that provide actionable insights for clients
  • Contribute to the development of More in Common's research agenda, identifying gaps and opportunities for new projects
  • Cultivate and secure exciting new research projects for More in Common by building relationships with and reaching out proactively to potential partners
Comms and External Engagement
  • Represent More in Common in external settings including media appearances, roundtables, events and conferences
  • Communicate research findings to diverse audiences including policymakers, civil society, and the media
  • Build and maintain relationships with research partners, academic institutions, and partner organisations 
Supervision
  • Support the development of research associates and assistants, providing day-to-day guidance, feedback, and structured professional development
  • Support a hard-working, intellectually-curious and fun team culture, modelling More in Common's values internally and externally


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

We look for great people before we look for specific qualifications and experience - so we are open to applications from candidates with great potential but limited experience. 
 
For this role, some experience in professional research or political setting is a plus. This might be in a research agency, think tank, comms or PR firm or other policy, public opinion or political organisation. The role is less suitable for someone whose primary experience is academia.
 
The key elements we’re looking for are:

  • Some professional experience in a research, polling, policy or political context
  • Excellent writing skills and some experience in producing a range of high-quality written outputs (such as reports, op-eds or briefings) for a variety of audiences
  • Some experience interpreting quantitative and qualitative data and producing outputs that tell a compelling story from this data.
  • A strong understanding of the UK political system and a keen interest in current affairs and public policy
  • The aptitude and desire to work in a fast-paced environment, delivering high-quality outputs for clients
  • Curiosity for understanding and engaging people, and a desire to use data to tell insightful stories about Britain today  
We understand that not everyone with the skillset for this role will have all of the above – that is fine. We are most interested in your intellect, aptitude and experience to date, and your willingness to throw yourself into tackling some of the biggest issues in understanding the forces driving British society apart.


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We will have a better chance of uniting divided societies if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political opinions, and life experiences. We particularly encourage applications from underrepresented and minority communities
 
More in Common wants to meet the aims and commitments set out in our equality policy. This includes not discriminating under the Equality Act 2010. We will include a set of questions related to this in our email acknowledging your application for this role - this will help us understand the diversity of our job applicants.  Answering these questions are completely voluntary and anonymous. The information provided will be kept confidential and will not be linked to your application. The information is going to be used to help us understand the diversity of our organisation.


DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY

The application deadline is Sunday 20 September 23:59.
 
Applications should include a CV and a short cover letter (max. two pages). In the covering letter, please write up to 300 words on something that surprises you about public opinion in the UK today, why it surprises, and how you’d like to investigate it further. You must include this in your application for it to be considered.
 
Please apply following the link below.

Develop and own the digital-channel Joint Business Plans with Sales.</p> <p>• Align plans with the Brand Media and Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) teams to maximise the efficiency and impact of total marketing investment, working with them to adjust plans where necessary due to commercial or operational blocks.</p> <p>• Champion data- and AI-driven commercial planning to sharpen investment decisions, forecasting and prioritisation.</p> <p><strong>Commercial, Social &amp; Growth</strong></p> <p>• Bring a commercial lens to everything the team does, spotting opportunities and gaps, developing retailer campaigns and propositions that turn existing and incremental marketing budget into substantial uplifts in product orders and strong return on investment, and partnering and leading with your Sales counterparts (including the Senior Sales Director, Pureplay) and retailers on these conversations.</p> <p>• Champion social-first collaborations with our retail partners (influencer, organic social and affiliate), amplified through wider full funnel (on and offsite) retailer-owned media activations to build reach, engagement and conversion.</p> <p>• Own the digital shelf and content excellence agenda (PDPs, brand stores, search and content) and ensure flawless GTM and NPD support, with assets, listings and launch readiness delivered in time and aligned to launch dates.</p> <p>• Lead the vertical’s presence at selected physical retailer events, partnering with Retail Excellence (Field &amp; description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About Us</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:280}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>SharkNinja&nbsp;is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively&nbsp;impact&nbsp;people’s lives in homes around the world. <strong>Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja</strong>, the company has a proven&nbsp;track record&nbsp;of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed&nbsp;SharkNinja&nbsp;to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than&nbsp;4,100&nbsp;associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>AI at SharkNinja </strong></p> <p>At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>SharkNinja's mission is to positively impact people's lives every day in every home around the world. As we continue to grow, we're adding an Engineering Director to our Advanced Development Floorcare team, based at our Battersea, London office.</p> <p>This role sits at the front end of floorcare product creation, bringing technical depth and inspiration to our creative process. You'll lead the technology and feasibility work that shapes our floorcare product roadmap, working at the intersection of mechanical systems and connected technology (sensors, software, batteries, connectivity) to define what our next generation of vacuums and floor care systems can become.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <p>Lead front end engineering development for floorcare products, using ideation and innovation techniques to unlock and drive the roadmap alongside engineering and cross functional PD, ID, Brand and Test Kitchen teams across the US, UK and China.</p> description: <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the role:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The Customer Success department is the backbone of Forter. As a Senior CSM, you are a key commercial lead responsible for the health, retention, and growth of our strategic accounts. We put a great deal of faith in our CSMs, who own not only customer satisfaction but also <strong>renewals, expansion, and strategic ROI</strong>. In this role, you’ll build lasting executive relationships and solve complex business challenges, developing the commercial and technical skills that will be the cornerstone of your future career.</span></p> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Own the Renewal Lifecycle:</strong> Act as the primary commercial owner for your book of business, managing the end-to- end renewal process and hitting retention targets.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Drive Net Revenue Growth:</strong> Identify and qualify upsell opportunities within your accounts, collaborating with Sales to expand Forter’s footprint.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Quarterback Executive Value:</strong> Lead MBRs and QBRs to communicate Forter’s performance, ROI, and strategic impact to client stakeholders.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Strategic Advocacy:</strong> Convert client success into commercial momentum by securing references and case studies that serve as sales accelerators.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Product &amp; Roadmap Influence:</strong> Translate client business needs into actionable insights for our Product and leadership teams to help shape the company roadmap.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Data Hygiene:</strong> Maintain accurate data within internal systems to ensure leadership has real-time visibility into the commercial health of your portfolio.</span></li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you’ll need:</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>5+ years of post-live, client-facing CS experience</strong> with a proven track record of managing renewals and hitting retention targets.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Commercial Acumen:</strong> Experience leading executive-level business reviews focused on ROI, budgets, and long-term contract value.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Strategic Planning:</strong> Ability to communicate client objectives to internal leadership to execute high-impact account strategies.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Industry Context:</strong> Experience in a SaaS startup; background in payments, fraud, or fintech is a significant bonus.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Problem-Solving Grit:</strong> Ability to break down ambiguous problems into concrete solutions and a willingness to get "in the weeds" to solve operational issues.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>High Agency:</strong> Trusted to drive initiatives autonomously and gain buy-in from a wide collection of internal and external stakeholders.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Benefits:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Competitive salary and bonus plan</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Restricted Stock Units (RSU's)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Private health insurance, including vision and dental coverage</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Generous PTO policy</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Half day Fridays, every Friday</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About Us:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Commerce is evolving faster than the systems built to support it. Agentic AI is redrawing how people buy. Customer expectations have a new ceiling. And bad actors are evolving alongside every advancement.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Forter was built to meet this moment — and stay ahead of it.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are a human-first, AI-built company. Our technology analyzes patterns across a network of over 2 billion shoppers, delivering identity intelligence across the entire commerce journey — from sign-up to checkout to returns — that protects revenue and unlocks great customer experiences simultaneously. With Forter, businesses know who to trust, whether it’s humans or the agents shopping for them. The result: zero friction for the customers who matter. No revenue left behind.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world's most trusted brands — Nordstrom, Instacart, Priceline, Adobe, ASOS, and eBay among them — rely on Forter to get this right. Since 2013, we've raised $525M from investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and today we power commerce decisions for nearly 1 million businesses globally. We're more than fraud, payments and orchestration – we make trust a competitive advantage.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Trust is backed by data –&nbsp; Forter is a recipient of over 10 workplace and innovation awards, including:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Great Place to Work Certification (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024,<a href="https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified-company/7039960"> 2025</a>)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Fortune’s Best Workplaces in NYC (2022, 2023, 2024 and<a href="https://www.greatplacetowork.com/best-workplaces/new-york/2024?category=small-and-medium"> 2025</a>)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Forbes Cloud 100 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and <a href="https://www.forbes.com/lists/cloud100/?sh=5675f5797d9c">2025</a>)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Anti-Fraud Solution of the Year at the Payments Awards (<a href="https://www.payments-awards.com/awards/winners24.php">2024</a>)</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Life as a Forterian:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Forterians are, genuinely, some of the best people you'll work with. Smart, curious, and deeply good humans who care about the work and each other. That's not an accident — it's something we've been intentional about since day one, and it's the thing people mention most when they talk about why they stay. When you're surrounded by people like this, doing work that actually matters, it changes what a job can feel like.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Forter was built on a simple but powerful conviction: when AI does its job, humans can do theirs better. That philosophy shapes our products and shapes how we work. AI is core to our workflows — not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier that gives Forterians the space to focus their energy where human judgment is irreplaceable.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We're a global team of 500+ people, with regional headquarters in New York, Tel Aviv, London, and Singapore, and employee presence across the US, Canada, Germany, France, Japan, China, and Australia. Our teams are cross-functional by design, and the work you do here is visible, consequential, and connected to the outcomes that matter.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You'll have real ownership here and proximity to decisions. And we back that with investment in your growth — RSU offerings, L&amp;D programs built around AI tools, and a culture of recognition rooted in our 4.5 day weeks (aka Forter’s Appreciation Fridays and Sundays). From team outings to local cultural celebrations, we mark the moments that matter — wherever you are in the world. We don't want Forter to be just another job. We want it to be the place you build.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">If you're ready to work on a problem that sits at the intersection of AI, commerce, and human trust, this is it.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><em>Forter is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that will consider all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetics, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><em>If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at ----- This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Hybrid work:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">At Forter, we embrace a hybrid work model that blends in-person connection with the flexibility of remote work. Team members based near our key hubs are expected to work from the office at least three days per week. We believe that regular face-to-face collaboration fuels professional development, strengthens our culture, and builds the relationships that help teams thrive.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><br><br></p> <div class="content-conclusion">&nbsp;</div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><a href="https://www.forter.com/job-applicant-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Forter's Applicant Privacy Policy</a></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
